Review comment:

- [P2] Reject oversized JSON integers without crashing — engine/regime_one.py:955-956
  When the saved ledger contains a syntactically valid but oversized integer probability—for example `"p_quad_filtered":{"Q1":<401-digit integer>,"Q2":0,"Q3":0,"Q4":0}`—`math.isfinite(v)` converts that `int` to a float and raises `OverflowError`. Neither `read_hmm_issuance` nor the ledger-validation path in `accrue_hmm_row` catches that exception, so the read-only inspection exits without the required explicit `invalid_record`/`invalid_ledger` evidence and an existing nightly ledger can crash rather than fail closed. Treat conversion overflow as an invalid prediction (and add an oversized-integer case alongside the nonfinite-number tests).
